title: Lamps and Levites

questions.question: How many lamps were on the lampstand?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:2 (ESV): "When you set up the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand."

questions.question: What was the lampstand made of?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:4 (ESV): "And this was the workmanship of the lampstand, hammered work of gold."

questions.question: Who was to be cleansed and offered to the Lord?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:6 (ESV): "Take the Levites from among the people of Israel and cleanse them."

questions.question: What was shaved off the Levites?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:7 (ESV): "And let them go with a razor over all their body..."

questions.question: The Levites were presented as what kind of offering?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:11 (ESV): "And Aaron shall offer the Levites... as a wave offering..."

questions.question: Who laid their hands on the Levites?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:10 (ESV): "And the people of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites."

questions.question: The Levites were taken instead of whom?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:16 (ESV): "Instead of the firstborn of all the people of Israel, I have taken them for myself."

questions.question: At what age did Levites begin their service in the tent of meeting (in this chapter)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:24 (ESV): "From twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to perform the work..." (Note: differs from ch 4 which says 30; possibly different levels of service).

questions.question: At what age did they withdraw from the duty of the work?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:25 (ESV): "And from the age of fifty years they shall withdraw from the duty of the work and serve no more."

questions.question: Why were the Levites given to Aaron?
options: To do the service of the people and make atonement, that there be no plague
questions.correctAnswer: To do the service of the people and make atonement, that there be no plague
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:19 (ESV): "To do the service used... and to make atonement... that there may be no plague..."

questions.question: After retirement (age 50), what could they do?
options: Minister to their brothers in the tent by keeping guard
questions.correctAnswer: Minister to their brothers in the tent by keeping guard
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:26 (ESV): "They minister to their brothers in the tent of meeting by keeping guard, but they shall do no service."

questions.question: What pattern did Moses follow for the lampstand?
options: The pattern that the Lord had shown Moses
questions.correctAnswer: The pattern that the Lord had shown Moses
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:4 (ESV): "According to the pattern that the Lord had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand."

questions.question: When did God sanctify the firstborn for Himself?
options: On the day that He sought down all the firstborn in Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: On the day that He sought down all the firstborn in Egypt
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:17 (ESV): "On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I consecrated them for myself."

questions.question: Who did the actual offering of the Levites before the Lord?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:21 (ESV): "And Aaron offered them as a wave offering before the Lord."

questions.question: What liquid was sprinkled on the Levites?
questions.explanation: Numbers 8:7 (ESV): "Thus you shall do to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of purification upon them..."

key_verse_text: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the people of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
